# Avsnitt 596 - Köplägen i september

**Feed**: fill-or-kill  
**Published**: 2026-09-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Fill or Kill episode (596, 1 September) covers Klarna after CEO Sebastian Siemiatkowski bought $10m of shares through Flat Capital, a possible robotics boom this autumn with the CCXI SPAC (merging with Agility Robotics) as a US proxy, and the Swedish/Nordic biotech rally, with Cinclus flagged ahead of its Q4 phase 3 readout. On the macro side, the hosts expect a weak, seasonally poor September with rising US long-term yields, oil and Iran worries, and index rebalancing. They hold large cash positions and plan to buy the dip. One host is long US long bonds via TLT, betting that yields have peaked.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 KLAR — Klarna | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host long after dip; CEO $10m buy via Flat, the second-largest US insider buy that day; 12m view much higher, $50 target

#### Reasoning

Host bought after the report and added in the dip near $14. Large insider buys (chairman $50m, CEO $10m through Flat) are seen as a strong signal. Moving from BNPL to higher-margin neobank services is viewed as right. With heavy short interest (30% of free float), the stock could rebound. Near-term macro/Germany worries leave timing uncertain, and host may trade out around $16.

#### Sell Triggers

- macro weakness in Germany hits results
- CEO buy proves to be only price support
- pivot beyond BNPL fails
- host takes profit around $16

> *"Jag tror att Klarna på 12 månader sikt kommer stå väldigt mycket högre."*

---

### 🟢 TLT — iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host long US long bonds, expects long yields to fall as Bessent/Fed act

#### Reasoning

Host believes worry about US long rates is peaking. Treasury can shorten issuance, as Yellen did, and the Fed could step in. A risk-off equity sell-off would also drive flows into bonds.

#### Sell Triggers

- deficit keeps ballooning
- Treasury does not shift issuance to short-term bills
- inflation re-accelerates

> *"Jag tror att den här oron är den peakar långstans här."*

---

### 🟠 CCXI — CCXI (Agility Robotics SPAC) | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Seen as best US robot proxy; ~$13 vs $10 SPAC floor; Nvidia involvement; host does not own

#### Reasoning

Host expects a humanoid-robot boom this autumn as training breakthroughs cut learning time. CCXI/Agility ticks many boxes, including Nvidia involvement and likely ETF/index inclusion. The $10 SPAC trust value limits downside before the vote. Host would buy after a September dip.

#### Sell Triggers

- SPAC vote fails or heavy redemptions
- robot hype fades
- no ChatGPT moment for humanoids

> *"jag tycker nog att CCXJ är den som ser ut att kunna bli en bra robotproxy för kapital"*

---

### 🟠 CINPHA — Cinclus Pharma | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

Phase 3 readout Q4; mcap ~SEK 600m vs ~388m cash; market not pricing success

#### Reasoning

Valuation stands out: the stock traded near cash at one point and has fallen from 40-50 to ~13 ahead of phase 3 data in Q4. Heavy cash burn and a hybrid financing agreement are risks. Hosts' view is to own biotechs with funded cash ahead of big events.

#### Sell Triggers

- phase 3 data fails
- cash burn forces dilutive raise
- financing agreement turns toxic

> *"Så det är intressant att titta på för det kommer en fas 3 i svensk biotech."*

---

### 🔴 XPEV — XPeng | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host sold at a loss; focus remained on car business

#### Reasoning

Host owned it for robot exposure, but the company kept focusing on cars, where competition is tough, so the host exited.

> *"Jag pratade ju om X-peng som jag ägde har sålt nu. Blev inte en bra affär."*

---

### 🟡 ABCL — AbCellera | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host holding; raised $200m at no discount, strong cash position

#### Reasoning

Host keeps the position. The $200m raise came with no discount and gives a cash buffer for partnering negotiations or going alone, in line with the 'raise when you can' view on biotech.

#### Sell Triggers

- biotech sector reverses
- rising rates hit biotech valuations

> *"Abcellera sitter jag på."*

---

### 🟡 MRVI — Maravai | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host holds; latest holding to rally

#### Reasoning

Host still owns it after a strong biotech August; no new action taken.

#### Sell Triggers

- biotech sector pullback deepens

> *"Maravai var det senaste som drog."*

---

### ⛔ SIVE — Sivers Semiconductors | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Report sent shares down ~20%; losses growing, pipeline unclear; hype-driven by Serenity

#### Reasoning

Hosts are sceptical: the pipeline grew but little has materialised, losses are widening, and the stock ran from ~5 to 100 on hype before falling to ~25. They say Serenity's 'halo is slipping'.

> *"det är liksom inte mycket som har liksom konkretiserats sen den stod i 5 kronor och har gått i 100. Utan förlusterna har blivit större."*
